passives.name: The Boy Who Dreamed of Becoming a Musician
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Does not take Weakness Gauge damage when the enemy has 150 or more Chain Points. Increases damage taken from Dark enemies and reduces damage dealt to them. Against non-Dark enemies, reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt, and reduces damage taken.
